name: @zaisma/net
summary: The online core: kinds of sync for characters, objects, events and turns, sharing one room. Each piece says what it shares, never how, and it runs the same on Zaisma's relay, on a game server in Zaisma's rooms, and on that game server run on a developer's own machine.

settings.name: minimum_interpolation_delay_ms
settings.summary: The least time behind the newest snapshot that others' characters are drawn. It grows by itself to how late and unevenly snapshots arrive, so they never stall or jump; lower it for fights that need the freshest view, raise it to smooth a poor connection more.

settings.name: maximum_extrapolation_ms
settings.summary: How far past the newest snapshot another character keeps moving while the next one is late, before it holds still. 0 never guesses.

settings.name: correction_smoothing_sec
settings.summary: How quickly a correction to the player's own character eases away when the game server saw it somewhere else: most of it is gone in about twice this. 0 jumps at once.

settings.name: snapshots_per_sec
settings.summary: How many times a second the characters' places are sent, by whoever is in charge of them: each player's game for their own on the relay, the game server with one. Never more than the steps a second.

settings.name: turn_time_limit_sec
settings.summary: How long a player has for their turn before it passes to the next. 0 is no limit.

settings.name: objects_owner_left_mode
settings.summary: What happens to a player's shared objects when they leave: removed, or handed to whoever is in charge of the room (the game server, or the room's host on the relay).

hooks.name: before_event
hooks.summary: On a game server, asked before a player's event reaches anyone, with true and the event ({ playerId, eventName, payload, roomState }); answer false to stop it.

hooks.name: before_object_change
hooks.summary: On a game server, asked before a player makes, changes or removes a shared object, with true and the change ({ playerId, changeKind, object, changes, roomState }); answer false to refuse it, and that player's copy is put right.

hooks.name: before_character_input
hooks.summary: On a game server, asked before a player's input moves their character, with the input as received and checked ({ characterId, playerId, roomState }); answer another input to change it, or null to drop it.

hooks.name: before_turn_move
hooks.summary: Where the room is decided (the game server, or the host's game on the relay), asked before a player's move in their turn counts, with true and the move ({ playerId, turnNumber, move, roomState }); answer false to refuse it.

hooks.name: character_corrected
hooks.summary: In a player's game, told when the game server saw the player's own character somewhere other than the game had it, with how far each field was off ({ characterId, difference, isSnapped }).
